ALLIANCE GROUP LIMITED ↗

IT Project Manager

Canterbury Full-Time
Register to Apply Sign In
Category: Information Technology Reference: Closing: 14 Aug 2026

Ko wai mātou – About Us 

At Alliance Group, we’re more than a global supplier of exceptional grass-fed lamb, beef, and venison. We’re a purpose-driven business committed to driving prosperity for our farming families and creating thriving environments for our people. With sites across the North and South Islands, we’re focused on performance improvement, innovation, and reducing our environmental impact.  

Te Tūranga – The Role  

We're looking for an experienced Project Manager to join our Technology team and help deliver key initiatives that support Alliance's future success.

You'll lead the successful delivery of technology projects across Alliance. You'll manage projects from initiation through to closure, ensuring outcomes are delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.

A key focus of this role will be the delivery of Alliance's Primary Processing Solution, a significant programme of work that will support operations across our six processing plants. Working closely with operational leaders, business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams, you'll help drive successful implementation and adoption while ensuring strong governance, risk management, and communication throughout the project lifecycle.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading end-to-end delivery of technology projects.

  • Developing and managing project plans, budgets, schedules, and resource requirements.

  • Building strong relationships with business stakeholders, executive sponsors, vendors, and technical teams.

  • Managing project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans.

  • Facilitating steering committees, workshops, and project meetings.

  • Monitoring project financial performance and resource utilisation.

  • Ensuring compliance with project governance frameworks and reporting requirements.

  • Supporting organisational change initiatives to enable successful project outcomes.

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of project management practices across the business.

Ō pūkenga – About You  

We're looking for a confident and experienced project professional who can balance strategic thinking with practical delivery.

You'll bring:

  • At least 5 years' experience delivering IT or technology projects.

  • Proven success leading medium to large-scale enterprise technology initiatives.

  • Experience working with both Agile and Waterfall project methodologies.

  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, including experience working with senior leaders and executive teams.

  • Experience managing project budgets, timelines, resources, and vendors.

  • Exposure to ERP or business systems implementation projects.

  • Excellent planning, communication, and problem-solving abilities.

  • A collaborative approach with the ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams.

Ideally, you'll also have:

  • A tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.

  • Experience in an evolution of manufacturing products.

  • A recognised project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner.

  • Agile or Scrum certification.

Ngā painga – What’s in it for you?  

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment  

  • Opportunities to grow your skills and career  

  • Competitive remuneration and benefits  

  • One week’s extra annual leave  

  • Access to wellbeing initiatives  

Ko koe pea tēnei? – Sound like your kind of role?  

If you're an experienced Project Manager who enjoys leading complex technology projects and building strong stakeholder relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of technology at Alliance.
